mechanism: D · meta — composes D0–D6 by building role

application.when: always evaluated once per resolved building at dressing-resolve time; selects exactly ONE preset whose role-predicate matches building.footprint.typeId / building.footprint.category / building.specialization.id (read from the no-mock semantic source per design §7); the chosen preset then biases and selects from the already-instantiated D0–D6 categories and appends its signature props. A preset is a COMPOSITION RULE, never a new sprite — every prop it names is an object that already lives in a D3/D4/D5/D6 category, and every wear/growth bias it sets is a scalar applied to D0/D1/D2 coverage. Presets are mutually exclusive (first matching predicate wins, evaluated in array order); a building with no matching predicate falls through to the generic dwelling_common preset so nothing is ever undressed.
avoid: inventing props not present in D0–D6
firing age/wealth/maintenance biases when dressingContext lacks a sim source (honest absence — skip the bias, do not fake it)
double-dressing (a preset never re-runs a D0–D6 category that already fired; it only re-weights selection and appends signature sockets)
application.chanceOrDensity: exactly 1 preset per building (deterministic selection); within a preset, each signature prop carries its own chance/density so two inns differ

objects.label: Inn / tavern identity
objects.biomeSkins: Composition rule is biome-agnostic; the props it references inherit their own biomeSkins from D3–D6 (e.g. the hanging sign's material host swaps cob→fieldstone→timber_frame→wattle_daub per grassland wall, and to each biome's wall host elsewhere). In dark biomes (deep_forest/volcanic/mystic) the preset raises the lit-multiplier on its lantern picks so the inn reads as a beacon; in arctic/tundra it biases the door-side ground props toward snow_capped content states and the wall coverage toward a wetness-driven frost skin.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {inn, tavern} OR building.specialization.id in the inn/tavern specialization arrays (wayfarers_rest, coaching_inn, ale_house, mead_hall, …). Composition — FIRES: a D3 hanging sign (d3_hanging_signs → swinging_trade_sign, above_door socket, signature, drivenBy role-glyph='mug/bed'), a D3 lantern-bracket pair (d3_wall_brackets → wrought_iron_bracket holding d3_wall_lanterns_lighting → iron_candle_lantern, left_of_door + right_of_door, lit, diurnal toggle, flicker profile 'warm'), a D3 strung-lantern line (d3_wall_lanterns_lighting → strung_festival_lights, roof_edge along the façade, hybrid lit), D6 barrels (d6_barrels → d6_barrel_wood, door-side perimeter cluster, content axis biased 'full', 2–4), a D6 bench (d6_benches_stools → d6_bench_wood, under a front window socket). BIAS: D0 weathering coverage mid (d0_dirt_grime, lived-in, not derelict) GATED on dressingContext.age (honest-absence skip if no source); a D5 trodden-path ground toward the door (d5_stepping_stones, high foot traffic). The signature is the lit sign + flanking lanterns + door-side barrels — the canonical 'inn glows and has a sign' silhouette. Reads building.specialization.id only; no faked occupancy.

objects.label: Blacksmith / forge identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic rule; referenced props carry their own biomeSkins. The forge-glow emissive and chimney-smoke particle are pure code and read identically in every biome, but the preset raises smoke opacity in cold/wet biomes (visible condensation plume) and tints the glow cooler in mystic/volcanic where the host material is exotic. Tool-rack and anvil props swap their wood/iron host tints per biome wall host.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId === 'blacksmith' OR building.footprint.category === 'craft' with specialization.id in the blacksmith array (weaponsmith, armorer, farrier, bell_founder, …). Composition — FIRES: the forge & anvil (D6 d6_tool_racks → d6_forge_anvil — a code light source, ember-orange glow emissive into the GL lighting pass, radius mid, diurnal OFF i.e. burns day+night, flicker 'forge', with the forge-smoke particle), the D4 chimney smoke (d4_chimney_stacks → d4_grass_brick_chimney, particle column from the roof ridge/gable socket), a D6 tool-rack (d6_tool_racks → d6_tool_rack holding d6_tool_item, wall-leaning side socket, tongs/hammers/horseshoes drivenBy role-glyph from specialization.specialtyItems), a D3 hanging trade sign (d3_hanging_signs → swinging_trade_sign, above_door, anvil/hammer glyph), and a soot-darkened D0 coverage bias on the façade around the chimney (d0_soot_smoke_stain → d0_soot_smoke_stain__forge_scorch, mask facing the chimney, falloff patchy). BIAS: D0 soot tint HIGH near the forge wall; D5 bare scorched ground near the working anvil. Signature = glow + smoke + anvil; the only role with an always-on light. NOTE: the anvil and tool-rack are D6 ground props (d6_forge_anvil, d6_tool_racks), NOT D4/D3 — corrected. The glow/smoke are honest only because the building is a working forge (specialization derived).

objects.label: Bakery identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; the oven-chimney smoke (a D4 chimney-stack particle) is universal and thinner/whiter than the smith's. The hanging-sign and awning props (D3) swap to the biome material/cloth host; the door wreath of grain (D3) biases to dried/preserved variants in arctic.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId === 'bakery' OR specialization.id in the bakery array (bread_baker, pastry_chef, pretzel_maker, …). Composition — FIRES: the oven-chimney smoke (D4 d4_chimney_stacks → d4_grass_brick_chimney, light particle plume, thinner than smith), a D3 hanging sign (d3_hanging_signs → swinging_trade_sign, above_door, pretzel/loaf glyph), a D3 cloth awning over the shop window (d3_awnings_canopies → cloth_market_awning, cloth, wind_sway because suspended), a D3 grain door-wreath (d3_wreaths_garlands → door_wreath, on the door), and a light flour-dust D0 coverage near the door (d0_dirt_grime, patchy, low). BIAS: D0 weathering LOW (a working shop is kept tidy) gated on dressingContext.maintenance (honest-absence skip). Signature = chimney smoke + awning + grain wreath. The cloth awning sways (suspension rule); the wood-slat variant if chosen would not. NOTE: the oven smoke is a D4 chimney-stack effect (d4_chimney_stacks), not D6 — corrected; a dedicated window bread-shelf prop has no object yet (honestly absent, not invented).

objects.label: Farmhouse / agricultural dwelling identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic rule; the hay/produce props (D6) reskin to the biome's crop catalog (grassland wheat/hay → desert gourds → tundra root-cellar mounds). In wet biomes the mud-coverage bias rises; the woodpile and fence props swap wood host per biome.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {cottage, house} located in an agricultural district (district.kind === 'agricultural') OR typeId === 'barn' OR specialization.category === 'agricultural'. Composition — FIRES: a D5 vegetable-row / kitchen-garden ground field (d5_vegetable_rows → d5_vegrow_furrow_mound holding d5_vegrow_crop_clump, perimeter, away from door_path), a D6 hay-bale and produce-crate cluster (d6_hay_bales → d6_hay_bale and d6_crates_boxes → d6_crate_wood, content axis biased 'loaded'/'full' seasonally), a D6 woodpile against a side wall socket (d6_woodpiles → d6_woodpile_split), a D6 split-rail fence run with a gate (d6_fences_gates → d6_fence_segment holding d6_gate_panel, tile-along the perimeter), a D4 simple porch over the door (d4_porches → d4_grass_timber_porch, if the footprint affords it). BIAS: a D2 light vine on a sun wall (d2_ivy_vines, rural, low trim) gated on age; honest field-dust D0 coverage on the lower façade (d0_mud_splash_base, mask direction up, falloff bottom). Signature = garden + hay/crates + fence. NOTE: the split-rail fence is a D6 prop (d6_fences_gates), not D5 — corrected. Seasonal produce uses the content axis, not wear states. District-kind is sim-derived (layout.js), so the rural identity is honest.

objects.label: Shrine / temple / chapel identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic rule; the votive-candle glow emissive (D6) is universal but the preset raises lit-multiplier in dark biomes so the shrine reads as a sacred light. The banner/symbol prop (D3) swaps role-glyph by deity domain (sun/moon/war/harvest/sea — from specialization.id), and in mystic/volcanic biomes the candles bias to magical-flame variants.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {shrine, chapel, temple, monastery, oracle_chamber} OR specialization.category === 'religious'. Composition — FIRES: a D3 religious banner / cult symbol (d3_banners_bunting → heraldic_banner, above_door socket, drivenBy role-glyph from specialization.id deity domain: sun_temple→sun disc, harvest_shrine→corn dolly, sea_chapel→coral charm), a D6 votive candle row (d6_shrine_furnishings → d6_votive_candle, foundation_edge or door-step, code emissive glow, lit day+night, flicker 'votive'), D6 offering bowls and incense (d6_offering_bowl and d6_incense_burner, door-step ground prop, content axis 'full'/'offerings'), a D5 swept clean approach path (d5_stepping_stones, biased ORDERLY — symmetric, not a desire-line), a D4 small portico/columns if the footprint affords (d4_columns_posts → d4_grass_stone_column, wealthy temples only). BIAS: D0 weathering LOW (d0_dirt_grime, maintained sacred site) gated on maintenance; a D2 deliberate ornamental vine on framed panels (d2_ivy_vines, trimmed) rather than wild. Signature = banner + candles + offerings + clean symmetric path. NOTE: the votive candle, offering bowl and incense burner are D6 shrine furnishings (d6_votive_candle/d6_offering_bowl/d6_incense_burner), not D3 — corrected. The candle glow is honest light from a real religious building (specialization-derived).

objects.label: Market shop / stall / bazaar identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; the goods on the ground crates/barrels and the stall (D6) reskin to the shop's specialty (specialtyItems from specialization.id) and to biome-available wares. The cloth awning swaps stripe palette per biome; in hot biomes it biases wider (more shade-span).
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {shop, bazaar, market_stall, trading_post} OR specialization.category === 'market'. Composition — FIRES: a D3 cloth shop-awning over the window/door (d3_awnings_canopies → cloth_market_awning, span fit, wind_sway — suspended cloth), a D3 hanging trade sign (d3_hanging_signs → swinging_trade_sign, above_door, role-glyph from specialization: spice_merchant→spice glyph, bookshop→book glyph), D6 goods crates and barrels (d6_crates_boxes → d6_crate_wood and d6_barrels → d6_barrel_wood, door-side perimeter, content 'loaded'/'full'), a D6 freestanding a-frame display board (d6_freestanding_signage → d6_aframe_board, near the road but avoid door_path), optionally a D6 market stall on a road-facing frontage (d6_market_stall). BIAS: D5 heavily trodden path (d5_stepping_stones, high customer traffic); D0 weathering LOW-MID (d0_dirt_grime, commercial frontage kept presentable) gated on maintenance. Signature = awning + sign + goods on display + a-frame board. NOTE: the a-frame board is a D6 freestanding-signage ground prop (d6_aframe_board), not a D4 prop — corrected; a dedicated window goods-shelf prop has no object yet (honestly absent, not invented). The awning sways (cloth suspension); wares are content-loaded, not wear states; specialty is specialization-derived (no generic 'shop').

objects.label: Guard post / barracks / garrison identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; the banner/standard (D3) swaps to the settlement's heraldic glyph and the brazier-glow (D6) raises lit-multiplier in dark biomes. Weapon-rack props swap wood/iron host per biome; in arctic the brazier biases to a larger always-on fire (warmth).
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {barracks, garrison, armory, watchtower} OR specialization.category === 'military' OR specialization.id === 'garrison'. Composition — FIRES: a D3 settlement standard / faction banner (d3_banners_bunting → heraldic_banner, above_door + roof_edge sockets, drivenBy role-glyph = settlement heraldry), a D6 brazier flanking the door (d6_braziers_fire → d6_iron_brazier, code emissive glow, diurnal ON — lit through the night watch, flicker 'brazier'), a D6 weapon rack (d6_arms_storage → d6_weapon_rack holding d6_arms_item spears/shields, wall or side ground socket, drivenBy role-glyph from specialtyItems), a D6 hitching post (d6_posts_tethers → d6_hitching_post, door-side), a D5 disciplined cleared approach (d5_stepping_stones, no clutter, no wild flora — biased SPARSE/ORDERLY). BIAS: D0 weathering MID (d0_dirt_grime, functional, not pampered); SUPPRESS D2 surface growth (d2_ivy_vines — a kept guard post is not overgrown). Signature = banner + brazier + weapon rack + austere cleared ground. NOTE: the weapon rack and brazier are D6 ground props (d6_arms_storage → d6_weapon_rack, d6_braziers_fire → d6_iron_brazier), not D4 — corrected. The brazier light is honest (a manned post). Suppression of vines is itself a composition decision (negative bias).

objects.label: Poor dwelling identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; props are humble and few. In wet biomes the patchy-rot D0 bias and D2 moss-coverage rise; in arctic the mend-patch and woodpile props bias heavier (survival). Any single window candle raises lit-multiplier in dark biomes.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId === 'cottage' (the smallest residential anchor) AND NOT in an agricultural district, OR a residential building whose dressingContext.wealth is LOW (gated — honest-absence: if no wealth source, fall back to the cottage-anchor proxy which IS sim-derived). Composition — FIRES: a SPARSE set — a D6 small woodpile (d6_woodpiles → d6_woodpile_split, one), a single D1 repaired/mended detail (d1_patched_repairs → d1_board_patch), a few D2 weed tufts (d2_wall_weeds_tufts → crack_grass_tuft) and a worn dirt path (d5_mud_patches → d5_mud_puddle_patch, not a tended garden), maybe one D3 shuttered window (d3_window_shutters → board_batten_shutter, open_close interact, plain). BIAS: D0 weathering MID-HIGH (d0_dirt_grime, peeling, water-stained — gated on age/maintenance, honest-absence skip), D2 moss/damp coverage MID on the shaded wall (d2_moss → moss_film), D1 light damage present (d1_cracks → d1_hairline_cracks, a cracked daub patch). DELIBERATELY OMITS: signs, awnings, ornamental columns, lit lanterns. Signature = humility through ABSENCE + honest wear. The wealth tier is a future sim param; until wired, the cottage anchor (sim-derived) is the honest proxy and richer biases stay dormant.

objects.label: Common dwelling identity (fallback)
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; this is the universal fallback so its referenced props are the most broadly-skinned set (flower box blooms reskin to the biome bloom catalog, fence/woodpile swap wood host). Lit-multiplier and climate-default states apply through the child categories.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {house} OR residential with no other preset match — THE FALLBACK preset (catches any building whose predicate matched nothing else, so no building is ever undressed). Composition — FIRES a MODERATE everyday set: a D3 flower box under a front window (d3_flower_boxes_planters → timber_flower_box, content axis season full/empty, bloom reskinned per biome), D3 shutters on windows (d3_window_shutters → board_batten_shutter, open_close interact, diurnal-ish), a D6 woodpile + a barrel or two (d6_woodpiles → d6_woodpile_split and d6_barrels → d6_barrel_wood, content 'full'), a D5 modest mixed garden + tufts around the perimeter (d5_flower_beds and d5_grass_tufts_clumps → d5_grasstuft_meadow_clump), a D5 normal desire-line path to the door (d5_stepping_stones), a D2 little vine on one sun wall (d2_ivy_vines, low). BIAS: D0 weathering MID (d0_dirt_grime, ordinary lived-in) gated on age; balanced — neither pristine nor derelict. Signature = the unremarkable lived-in home; the baseline every other preset is measured against. This is the no-match safety net required by the application rule.

objects.label: Wealthy dwelling / manor / villa identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; the ornamental props (columns, urns, trimmed hedge) carry the richest style variants and swap their stone/finish host per biome wall host. Lit carriage-lamps raise lit-multiplier in dark biomes; in arctic the trimmed hedge biases to evergreen/topiary, in desert to potted ornamentals.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId in {manor, villa} (the largest residential anchors) OR residential with dressingContext.wealth HIGH (gated — honest-absence: fall back to the manor/villa anchor proxy, which IS sim-derived). Composition — FIRES an ORNATE, MAINTAINED set: D4 portico / entry columns (d4_columns_posts → d4_grass_stone_column, structural attachment, own depth), D4 railings/balustrade on the porch (d4_railings_balustrades → d4_grass_timber_railing), D3 lit carriage-lamps flanking the door (d3_wall_lanterns_lighting → iron_candle_lantern, lit, diurnal toggle, flicker 'lamp'), D3 ornamental shutters (d3_window_shutters → board_batten_shutter, open_close, decorative), a D5 trimmed hedge run (d5_hedges → d5_hedge_trimmed_box_run, tile-along, SHAPED not wild), D5 flower beds + D6 ornamental urns (d5_flower_beds and d6_decorative_vessels → d6_ornamental_urn, content 'full'/'flowering'), a D5 clean dressed-stone or paved approach path (d5_stepping_stones, orderly, symmetric). BIAS: D0 weathering LOW (d0_dirt_grime, well-maintained — gated on maintenance), D2 surface growth SUPPRESSED except a deliberate trained ornamental vine on a trellis (d2_ivy_vines grown on a D4 d4_trellises_pergolas). DELIBERATELY OMITS: derelict wear, wild weeds, heavy moss. Signature = columns + lit lamps + trimmed hedges + clean paved path. NOTE: the ornamental urns are D6 decorative vessels (d6_decorative_vessels → d6_ornamental_urn). Wealth is a future sim param; the manor/villa anchor (sim-derived) is the honest proxy until the chronicle wealth source lands.

objects.label: Abandoned / ruined building identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; the decay reads heaviest where the biome already favours it — D2 moss/vine coverage maxes in forest/dense_forest/swamp/wet biomes, frost-cracked in arctic, sand-buried lower courses in desert. Boards and debris props swap wood host per biome. No lit anything (lit-multiplier forced to 0 — a dead building emits no light).
objects.notes: Predicate: dressingContext.condition === 'abandoned' OR 'ruined' — HONEST ABSENCE: there is NO sim source for building abandonment today (the chronicle does not yet emit decommission/ruin events). This preset is therefore DECLARED but DORMANT — it never fires until a settlement-chronicle abandonment event populates dressingContext.condition. It does NOT fabricate ruins from any available proxy (no faking 'this looks old so it's abandoned'). When wired, Composition — FIRES the decay maximum: D2 heavy wild vines (d2_ivy_vines, grow-fit, full coverage, climbing over apertures — the ONE case vines are allowed to cross windows), D2 moss coverage HIGH (d2_moss → moss_film, all faces, patchy), D1 structural damage HIGH (d1_missing_tiles_gaps → d1_missing_roof_tile and d1_plank_gap, broken_state on windows/door/roof, debris scatter → object-permanence deltas), boarded-up windows and door (nailed planks via d1_patched_repairs → d1_board_patch), D2 overgrown weeds reclaiming the path (d2_wall_weeds_tufts → crack_grass_tuft, no trodden line — nobody walks here), D6 collapsed/leaning props (d6_fences_gates → d6_fence_segment in its 'leaning' state). BIAS: D0 weathering MAX (d0_dirt_grime and d0_water_stains_streaks — rot, stain, bleach), and SUPPRESS every D7 'living' signal (no smoke, no light, no goods, no banner). Signature = boards + max vines/moss + broken openings + reclaimed ground. NOTE: there is no dedicated board-up sprite object; the nailed planks reuse the real D1 board-patch (d1_board_patch), honestly, rather than inventing one. The destructible deltas are honest only if the chronicle actually destroyed the building. Until then: honestly absent.

objects.label: Mill identity
objects.biomeSkins: Biome-agnostic; the wheel/sail prop type is chosen by the mill's power source and biome water-proximity (grassland/river/lake → water-wheel via the D4 water-wheel prop on a water-facing socket; open grassland/desert → windmill sails). Grain-dust D0 coverage and flour-sack props (D6) are universal; in wet biomes the lower courses bias to damp/algae coverage.
objects.notes: Predicate: building.footprint.typeId === 'mill' OR specialization.category === 'agricultural' with specialization.id in the mill array (grain_mill, lumber_mill, fulling_mill, …). Composition — FIRES: the D4 mill mechanism (d4_mill_mechanism) — a water-wheel (d4_water_wheel, if dressingContext.wetness HIGH / water-proximate, sim-derived from terrain-suitability) OR windmill sails (d4_windmill_sails, if exposed/open) — a large structural attachment with its own depth at a primary socket, D6 grain/flour sacks and full barrels (d6_sacks_baskets → d6_sack_grain and d6_barrels → d6_barrel_wood, content axis 'full', door-side), a D6 millstone prop (d6_mill_props → d6_millstone, ground, side socket), a D3 trade sign (d3_hanging_signs → swinging_trade_sign, above_door, sheaf/cog glyph from specialtyItems), fine grain-dust D0 coverage on the lower façade (d0_dirt_grime, pale, mask up, falloff bottom) and a flour-dust particle near the working door. BIAS: a D5 worn cart-track approach (d5_mud_patches → d5_mud_puddle_patch, heavy laden carts), D0 weathering MID (working structure). Signature = the wheel/sails + grain sacks + flour dust. Wheel-vs-sails is chosen from sim-derived water-proximity, not faked; the dust is honest for a working mill (specialization-derived).

crossBiomeNotes: D7 presets are COMPOSITION RULES, not sprites, so they are inherently biome-agnostic: each preset is authored once and fires identically in all 21 biomes. ALL biome specialization happens in the child fields D0–D6 that a preset references — a preset never owns a sprite to reskin. The preset's ONLY cross-biome levers are: (1) lit-multiplier — presets with light sources (inn/smith/shrine/guard/wealthy) raise their child lanterns'/braziers'/candles' lit-multiplier in dark biomes (deep_forest, dense_forest, swamp, volcanic, mystic) so identity reads as a beacon, and force it to 0 for abandoned_ruin (a dead building emits no light); (2) climate-default-state bias — presets push their child content/coverage toward the biome climate default (door-side barrels → snow_capped in arctic/tundra, lower façade → sand-buried in desert, D2 moss/vine coverage → MAX in wet/forest biomes and frost-cracked in arctic); (3) flora-reskin pass-through — garden/hedge/produce props (farmhouse, common, wealthy, mill) reskin to each biome's bloom/crop catalog via the child D5/D6 categories; (4) material-host pass-through — every signage/awning/rack/column prop swaps to the biome's wall material host (grassland: cob/fieldstone/timber_frame/wattle_daub) through its child category, never here. Selection of WHICH preset fires reads only the no-mock semantic source (building.footprint.typeId / category / specialization.id, plus district.kind), which is 100% sim-derived and deterministic in every biome. The two wealth-tiered presets (dwelling_poor/wealthy) and abandoned_ruin lean on dressingContext params (wealth, condition) that have no sim source yet: their richer biases stay DORMANT and they fall back to sim-derived anchor proxies (cottage / manor-villa) — honest absence, never faked across any biome.
